findingsReturnedAtReceipt.title: Fail or retry when scheduling the next raw chunk
findingsReturnedAtReceipt.originalText: When `dispatcher.Post` throws after a partial read, `Wake()` only resets `posted` and returns, while this branch has already detached the completed Ensure callback and relies solely on `wake()` to pump the next chunk. A raw file larger than one chunk can therefore remain pending indefinitely with its file stream and global raw-byte reservation retained unless another provider API call happens to invoke `Drain`; handle the scheduling failure by terminating the operation or arranging a guaranteed retry.

nativeAssociation.association: The first RAW PR maps published bytes and its naturally generated metadata to the fixed composite evidence without rewriting the original RAWHead=null receipt. The native result is not a full PR-head build or review.
